{{Quote|The Voidwolf's been using a powerful Planetary Sensor Station to "tag" any ships leaving Quesh's surface. Then his fleet homes in and "boom".|Ozzik|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ozzik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of his own ship and a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] his and [[Beryl Thorne]]'s supply fleet got grounded on [[Quesh]] by the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] and Ozzik called a fellow privateer [[Voidhound]] for help. After meeting the fellow captain, Ozzik explained that the ships were prevented from leaving by the [[Planetary Sensor Station]] and asked the Voidhound to sabotage it. The operation was successful and Ozzik's fleet was able to depart from Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
